07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Case No. GPA-2017-02; Z-2017-01; SP-2017-02; DR-2017-20; TPM 77104 Location: Northeast corner of Todd Avenue and 10th Street
APN: 8617-001-005
Public scoping meeting in conjunction with this Notice of Preparation to present the project and the Environmental Impact Report (EIR) process and to receive public comments and suggestions regarding the scope and content of the EIR. The proposed project would redevelop a portion of the existing golf course at the Azusa Greens Country Club to build a luxury senior housing complex. The project will involve a General Plan Amendment, Zone Change, Specific Plan, Design Review, and a Tentative Parcel Map.
